name: vigilai-project-overview-film
description: Editable Remotion source for the project-overview film. Kept separate from the website runtime.

scripts.music: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON scripts/export-timeline.ts && uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with numpy python music/compose.py
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts ProjectOverview out/project-overview-master.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 12 --pixel-format yuv420p --muted --props=render-props.json
scripts.media: pnpm fonts && pnpm verify && pnpm music && pnpm render && pnpm poster && pnpm export
